patch_list: Hide playback controls at stream open
Keeps playback controls hidden when a stream opens or the player switches between embedded and fullscreen. The controls remain available.
Helps the Android TV remote reveal native playback controls and focus the seekbar when available. Live streams may not be seekable.
Pin favourite categories to the top

Long-press a category to pin it to the top of the Category list. Long-press a pinned category to reorder it. On Android TV the menu offers Arrange to move several in one go, Move to top, Move left and Move right one place, and Move up and…
Removes ads, tracking, and forced updates, and keeps channels working after patching.
